policy: Frame-time targets of the browser apps: 120 fps most of the time, never below 60. Every budget is in report mode until the optimization phases land; switch a budget (or the whole file) to "enforce" to make a miss fail `make perf-frames-check` and the CI job.

metrics.commitP95Ms: 95th percentile (nearest rank) of the main-thread time of one commit, over the commits of the interaction (scope pooled: of every commit of the profile)
metrics.longTaskCount: main-thread tasks over 50 ms (PerformanceObserver longtask) during the interaction
metrics.longTaskMaxMs: duration of the longest of them
metrics.timeShare16: percent of the active time of the interaction spent in frame intervals of at most 16.7 ms (+0.1 ms timestamp rounding)
metrics.timeShare8: same for 8.3 ms, one 120 Hz frame
metrics.slowFrames16: frame intervals over 16.7 ms (+0.1 ms) during the interaction
metrics.shareInteractionsWithoutSlowFrame: pooled only: percent of the interactions with no frame interval over 16.7 ms

budgets.name: desktop-commit-p95
budgets.rationale: A commit that fits one 120 Hz frame leaves the rest of the frame to the browser's own rendering.

budgets.name: desktop-commit-p95-all
budgets.rationale: The same limit over every commit of every interaction: the headline number, with more samples than any single interaction has.

budgets.name: desktop-long-tasks
budgets.rationale: No main-thread task over 50 ms during any interaction of the measured app.

budgets.name: desktop-frames-within-16ms
budgets.rationale: At least 99% of the active time is spent in frames that make 60 fps.

budgets.name: desktop-frames-within-16ms-each
budgets.rationale: Reported per interaction to locate the frames that miss the pooled limit.

budgets.name: desktop-frames-within-8ms
budgets.rationale: Reported: the share of the active time in frames that make 120 fps (no limit yet).

budgets.name: phone-no-slow-frame
budgets.rationale: On a CPU four times slower no frame may take longer than 16.7 ms: the app never drops below 60 fps.

budgets.name: phone-interactions-without-slow-frame
budgets.rationale: "Most interactions" run without a slow frame (at least half) even while the per-interaction budget above is not met everywhere; tighten this limit as the app gets there.

budgets.name: phone-frames-within-16ms
budgets.rationale: Reported: the share of the active time in 60 fps frames.

budgets.name: phone-long-tasks
budgets.rationale: Reported: long tasks per interaction with a CPU four times slower.

budgets.name: phone-longest-task
budgets.rationale: Reported: the longest task per interaction with a CPU four times slower.

budgets.name: phone-commit-p95
budgets.rationale: Reported: per-commit main-thread time with a CPU four times slower.
